subject: Air freight quote: CGN to LIM
body:
Hi,

Could you quote the fastest air freight option from CGN to LIM (Lima, PE), all-in in EUR?

We'll deliver to CGN ourselves. The shipment will be ready on 2026-11-28: 1 piece of printed marketing material, 1745 kg gross, 5.54 cbm.

Please confirm the earliest departure and arrival.

Mira Petersen
Nordlicht Audio

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting a new air freight quote for a specific shipment.
